description: Hand-write these. Score retrieval (expected sources in top-k) separately from answer quality. Fluent-but-wrong is a fail: the answer must include every must_contain phrase and none of must_not_contain. Refuse cases must say I don't know and attach no citations. Comparison and ranking cases must cite every expected source and must not invent a winner.

questions.question: What is Ask My Docs?
questions.notes: Should mention answering from local documents with citations.

questions.question: Where should I put notes to query?
questions.notes: The docs/ folder. Markdown or txt.

questions.question: What should I do before calling the LLM when debugging retrieval?
questions.notes: Print the top chunks; do not call the LLM until retrieval looks right.

questions.question: If I change a markdown file, do I need to do anything special?
questions.notes: Re-ingest; stale index is expected in v1.

questions.question: What is the weather in Tokyo tomorrow?
questions.notes: Not in the docs. Must refuse / say I don't know. No fake citations.

questions.question: who is better? lebron or curry?
questions.notes: Grounded comparison. Both Notes must be retrieved. Compare documented facts; do not name a winner.

questions.question: who is the best player?
questions.notes: Ranking with no criterion. Retrieve the player Notes, compare documented facts, do not crown a best player.

questions.question: Who won the 2024 Super Bowl?
questions.notes: Not in the docs. Must refuse. No fake citations.
